craft_notes: Sthāyin: Wonder at all-containing, marveled into refuge. End-dash→comma (extolling softens onto asking). Rejected: 'wage' for 'meed' — meed is older; kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: The eldest root-stock of the triple morrow we extol,
what meed craves he, the all-accomplished?
l4.sanskrit_cite: stumas tribhuvanārambhamūlaprakṛtim īśvaram lipseran nopakāraṃ ke yataḥ sampūrṇadharmaṇaḥ

reads_against.argmap: We praise the lord, root-nature of three-world beginning. → None seeks service from the perfect-natured lord.
c1_essence: Flawless taproot sought by none; remembrance lucidity hymned.

l2.plain_english: The lord we laud, taproot of the triple world's start — who would beg a favour of the flawless?
